description: This file defines a Python class '_ENTERPRISE_BlockedUserList' used for managing and checking a blocked user list within an enterprise context. It includes functionality for initializing the blocked user list from various sources (list, string filepath), logging, and an asynchronous pre-call hook to prevent blocked users from making API calls.
